review: Independent review 2026-10-07 of records newly approvable after #168 (listed parenthetical variants, B.Ed. and PVAMU awards). Correct records are promoted by programs/decisions/*-r1007f.json; these stay held.

held.reason: Combined bachelor's+master's program: heading 'Exercise Science (B.S.) - Therapeutic Science & Athletic Training (M.S.)' under 'Combined Degree: Bachelor of Science in Exercise Science (B.S.) - Therapeutic Science & Master of Science in Athletic Training (M.S.)'; program_name 'Exercise Science (B.S.)' is not the page's title, and base 'Exercise Science Major (B.S.)' has its own page in the nav.

RN-licensure completion pathway of a degree with its own page and list line: nav and official list both print 'Nursing Major (B.S.N.)' alongside 'Nursing Major (R.N. to B.S.N.)'; same award ('39 hours of advanced credit will automatically be applied toward students' Bachelor of Science in Nursing'). Under the listed-variant rule a base line for the same degree and award exists, so this is a variant. (Arguably a distinct entry pathway; flag if RN-to-BSN completion programs should be kept.)

held.program_name: Nursing Practice (D.N.P.) - Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (Post B.S.N.)
held.reason: Graduate/doctoral program: Graduate Catalog page 'Nursing Practice (D.N.P.) - Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (Post B.S.N.)', NURS 7xx/8xx/9xx courses, 'Complete 66 hours ... post-graduate and doctoral degree'. Not a bachelor's.

Combined bachelor's+master's program: heading 'Public Health (B.S.) - Community Health Promotion & Public Health (M.P.H.) - Community Health Promotion' under 'Combined Degree: ...'; program_name 'Public Health (B.S.)' is not the page title, and base 'Public Health Major (B.S.)' has its own page in the nav.

Page itself looks like a bachelor's program (heading 'Juvenile Justice, BSCJ', 'Academic Catalog 2026-2027', 'Bachelor of Science in Juvenile Justice Degree Program Requirements', own 36-hour major, own nav entry; the Criminal Justice page says the department offers 'Bachelor of Science degrees in Criminal Justice and Juvenile Justice'). But it is absent from the official program list (no list line), its award code is BSCJ (the Criminal Justice award), and the Criminal Justice BSCJ also lists 'juvenile justice' as one of its five concentrations, so whether it is a separate degree or a duplicate/legacy BSCJ variant can't be confirmed.

held.program_name: Bachelor of Science Degree in Mathematics (Second Major)

Also the Mathematics - Undergraduate nav prints a base 'Mathematics BS' page of its own.
